{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
cleaned_revenue = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for the QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}')

# Also check the actual cleaned values to confirm
qa_cleaned = cleaned_revenue[cleaned_revenue == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders in cleaned revenue: {len(qa_cleaned)}')"}
